text: I give no trade instructions or contract counts; sizing comes only from pmstack/sizing.py in paper risk units and the decision stays with Bernardo. As facts: US corn 2026/27 stocks-to-use is 11.3% (42nd percentile since 2007/08, WASDE 2026-10-09), and WASDE days have been more volatile than the days around them (ratio 1.314, t 5.2, 295 releases), which is contemporaneous and predicts no direction. Inference: the 10 November WASDE is a volatility event, not a signal; any idea should go through the journal with its invalidation and the critic's card.
